Editor's note—
Ord. No. 4095, § 1, adopted November 19, 2007
, repealed Art. III, §§ 38-121—38-134, 38-161—38-171, in its entirety, which pertained
               to nuisances. Section 2 of said ordinance enacted provisions designated as a new Art.
               III, §§ 38-121—38-125, 38-141, 38-161, to read as herein set out. See the Code Comparative
               Table for a detailed analysis of inclusion.
Cross reference—
Nuisance animals, § 14-53.
State Law reference—
Power of city council to define, abate and fine for nuisances, C.R.S. § 31-15-401;
               abatement of public nuisances, C.R.S. § 16-13-301 et seq.
